decoded.meaning: A label element whose declared payload is THREE bytes, not four. A label is exactly 4 bytes (RFC-0027 4.1), so these bytes are a malformed address: a hop that implements labels MUST refuse them - ERROR{tr::path::invalid} (0x0021) - and MUST NOT read a short field as a label. A hop that does not implement kind 0x16 still steps over the record by its declared length, which is why the frame is carriable at all.
decoded.note: Not a reject.bin case: a packed PATH body is opt.PL = 0, opaque bytes to the codec, so there is nothing here for a codec to refuse - the same reasoning as path/path-escape-in-key-context. The requirement is a RESOLVER requirement.
